report: Severe back/chest pain, light-headedness, IVDU, prosthetic tricuspid valve, and shock point to infective endocarditis. TEE shows pulmonic valve vegetations and severe tricuspid regurgitation from a flail leaflet; ECG conduction abnormality suggests perivalvular extension. PE, aortic syndrome, and post-procedure complications are less likely. Pending cultures and incomplete lead/pericardial assessment temper confidence, but IE with septic shock is the leading diagnosis.
